_about: EZdrummer 3 note -> General MIDI note (what Guitar Pro expects on a percussion track). Notes not listed are passed through unchanged (36 kick, 38 snare, 40 rimshot, 37 sidestick, 41/43/45/47/48 toms, 49/57 crashes, 51 ride, 53 ride bell, 55 splash, 59 ride edge/crash).
_source: Inferred from EZdrummer 3's groove database (%APPDATA%/Toontrack/EZdrummer 3/MidiDB: every groove lists the kit pieces it uses; a note belongs to the piece present in 100% of grooves containing it) and from the articulation names stored in .midtrackinfo files next to MIDI dragged out of EZdrummer. Toontrack maps can differ per kit: check yours in EZdrummer and override with --drum-map.

52.name: Ride Edge (China in Toontrack's generic map; this kit names it Ride Edge)
